answer: Require every identity to lock a marble — a collateral bond — into a shared escrow bridge before it can open its first trading channel. Honest agents pay once and reuse standing collateral as their record grows into a dense grove of verified trades; reputation compounds on one identity, never on many. A Sybil attacker must post a fresh marble for each fake identity and pay per-channel lockup, so ten thousand ghosts cost ten thousand bonds — real money per identity — while honest agents simply pay once and keep trading.
